query: SELECT p.categoryId, c.name as categoryName, c.slug, MIN(p.name) as sampleProduct FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.categoryId = c.id WHERE p.active = 1 GROUP BY p.categoryId, c.name, c.slug ORDER BY p.categoryId
